size_why: Thirty-six lines but zero systems, economy, map or objective changes — it is all hero kit tuning plus one item curve. The tier list moves a little; how souls are made and where fights happen does not move at all.
headline: A cleanup pass on the 10-30 outliers: Valve trims the strong (Baba, Celeste, Deadman Danny), feeds the weak (Rat King, Apollo, Mo & Krill) and quietly shrinks stacked anti-heal.

meta_thesis.previous: Leads must be converted into Guardians and Walkers fast because the 10-30 comeback levers and richer Haunts keep paying the trailing team, so one-cycle camp clearers who spend the lead early and late scalers with a farm floor are the winners.
meta_thesis.new: Identical economy, identical map: the game is still won by farming Haunts and converting before comeback gold arrives. What changed is who survives the mid-fight — stacked anti-heal is weaker, so kit healers and self-sustain bruisers hold longer, and the outlier frontlines from 10-30 were trimmed.
meta_thesis.why: The General/systems sections are empty and the only non-hero change is Healbane's stacking curve. Every mover here comes from individual kits and one item's diminishing returns, not from soul income or objective timers.

winners.why: Buffs land exactly where 10-30 hurt: bullet damage 5.7->5.8, ammo 24->26, and Rule, Ratannia! T1 now cuts 25s off the 180s ult.
The multi-source anti-heal that blanked Frozen Shelter caps at 72% (was 82.2%), so the best healer is harder to fully shut off.
Riposte Pommel Hit now disarms and T2 holds 0.6s->0.7s, turning his parry into a gun-carry shutdown — though it is still an immobilize, not a stun, so channels no longer break.
Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow radius +0.5m and Combo HP per kill 40->50 give the tank more of the thing he does; the anti-heal cap compounds it.
The 10-30 stack system that crushed tether healing is partially reversed (4-stack 82.2%->72%), and her gun core is untouched.

losers.why: Every pick tool shrank at once: silence T3 +1.25s->+0.75s, Radiant Daggers 30m->25m, Shining Wonder slow -32%->-28% and cooldown 160s->170s.
Close The Deal execute +75%->+55%, Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8% and Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150->125 gut the dive-pick identity on a hero who must commit.
Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5 plus melee damage -10% per boon cuts the resist wall her regen bruiser build stands behind.
His anti-heal bruiser variant stacked built-in heal cut on Healbane/Toxic Bullets — exactly the two-source case trimmed 57.8%->54.7% — and Apollo's rework sharpens a listed loss.
Both worst matchups got harder: Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs and Ivy's rebound from the anti-heal cap, while her single-target rotation gains nothing.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Healbane was not nerfed — single-source anti-heal is identical, so this is a tax on redundant buyers, not a nerf to the item.
non_obvious_calls.why: Only the 2-stack (57.8%->54.7%) and 4-stack (82.2%->72%) curves moved; the first purchase decision is unchanged and triple-Healbane comps are the actual target.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Baba is still a top frontline despite the nerf stack.
non_obvious_calls.why: Tiers come from measured data, not notes: 54.4% win rate after every resist and melee cut, same shape as her 10-30 nerfs that left her top of the table.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Rat King's real buff is a talent line, not the stat bumps.
non_obvious_calls.why: Rule, Ratannia! T1 adding -25s cooldown is the cheapest answer to the 180s ult that 10-30 left as his problem — earlier than any Cooldown item.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Apollo's Riposte is a rework, not a straight buff.
non_obvious_calls.why: Pommel Hit is an immobilize plus parry disable, so it can no longer interrupt channels; the added disarm pays into gun carries only, and the Pummel parry-strip wording stays unresolved.

uncertainties: The Pummel 'ends a preexisting parry' line: whether it strips the target's parry state or Apollo's own is unclear, and it decides how strong his duel is.
Baba's tier: 54.4% win rate argues S, but a ~29% resist-scaling cut is structural — she may drift a tier by week two rather than immediately.
Graves' 57.5% win rate still conflicts with the KB's 48.5%/21% snapshot; nothing here touches her kit, so the number cannot be validated by this patch.
Whether Celeste's nerfs actually cost her a tier outside the losing lanes she already dominated, since her burst numbers were untouched.
what_to_watch: Healbane purchases per team — if the average drops toward one, the anti-heal coverage plan is dead and kit healers rebound further.
Kelvin, Ivy and Rem win rates: the cleanest read on whether the stacking cap is worth three points of heal throughput.
Deadman Danny's pick rate and win rate — a fifth off the execute should show fast on a dive hero.
Mo & Krill pick rate into frontline-heavy lobbies, as the answer to Baba and Viscous.
Celeste's T3 talent pick rate: if players abandon the silence talent, her pick identity shifted, not just her numbers.

biggest_changes.subject: Healbane
biggest_changes.title: Second and third anti-heal copies are much weaker
biggest_changes.why: 4-stack heal cut 82.2%->72% with 20% faster decay; one source is unchanged.

biggest_changes.subject: Celeste
biggest_changes.title: Silence, cast range and ult all shortened
biggest_changes.why: Dazzling Trick silence +1.25s->+0.75s and Radiant Daggers 30m->25m cut her pick window 40%.

biggest_changes.subject: Rat King
biggest_changes.title: Ult cooldown talent and gun stats buffed
biggest_changes.why: Rule, Ratannia! T1 adds -25s cooldown and ammo goes 24->26.

biggest_changes.subject: Baba
biggest_changes.title: Resist wall and melee damage cut again
biggest_changes.why: Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5 and melee damage -10% per boon.

biggest_changes.subject: Deadman Danny
biggest_changes.title: Execute and dive sustain both trimmed
biggest_changes.why: Close The Deal bonus damage +75%->+55% and Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150->125.

biggest_changes.subject: Apollo
biggest_changes.title: Parry now disarms gun carries
biggest_changes.why: Pommel Hit adds a disarm and Riposte T2 duration goes +0.6s->+0.7s — but it no longer interrupts channels.

biggest_changes.subject: Mo & Krill
biggest_changes.title: More Scorn healing, bigger Burrow, healthier grab
biggest_changes.why: Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Burrow damage radius +0.5m, Combo HP per kill 40->50.
